name: hermes
//workspaces: apps/ is the deployable surfaces (today: the Next app), packages/ the libraries they share, services/ the long-lived processes and CLIs. tools/ is deliberately absent: manimkc, remotionkc, revideokc, blenderkc and tldrawkc are git submodules with their own repos, lockfiles and toolchains, and listing them here would make npm try to install them as part of this tree.
//scripts: The web app's own scripts live in apps/web/package.json; the four below delegate to them so `npm run dev` from the repo root still does the obvious thing. lint, typecheck and test stay here because they span every workspace: one ESLint config and one vitest config cover the whole tree, and typecheck fans out through --workspaces.
//canvas: A launcher rather than `node tools/tldrawkc/dist/cli/index.js`, so this script and the diagram indexer resolve TLDRAWKC_ROOT through one function in services/catalog/src/env.ts. Shell expansion cannot: it reads only the process environment, so a root set in services/catalog/.env would reach the indexer and not this, and it leaves a leading ~ literal. The launcher forwards every argument and exits with the child's code, so exit 3 for `inspect` still means lints remain.
//worktree-setup: The one command for a fresh clone or worktree: npm ci, a starter apps/web/.env.local, the submodule fetches it can reach, the tools/tldrawkc build, and a scratch catalog migrate as the sanity check. --with-video-env adds the video tools' environments, --skip-tldraw leaves the diagram tool out; --help has the rest.

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev & DEV=$!; npm run studio & STUDIO=$!; while [ "$(jobs -rp | wc -l)" -ge 2 ]; do sleep 1; done; kill $(jobs -rp) 2>/dev/null; wait $DEV; DEV=$?; wait $STUDIO; STUDIO=$?; [ $DEV -eq 0 ] || exit $DEV; exit $STUDIO

//overrides: @tailwindcss/typography pins postcss-selector-parser 6.0.10 exactly, which carries GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf (quadratic selector parsing). 6.1.5 is the same major with the fix; drop this once typography releases a version that depends on it.
